en.title: Agent loop · explore → plan → change → verify → commit
en.description: Step a small Aether Library repo task through the Claude Code loop — explore, plan, change, verify, commit — without API keys.

steps.content: In my local Aether Library clone: add one glossary term "hallucination" following the existing structure. Do not invent sources. Stop for approval before any file write.
steps.annotation: Smallest useful change. Same vehicle as solos A1–A4.

steps.content: Starting at explore: I will only read. Mapping Profiles, Glossary, Library, and how glossary entries are shaped.
steps.annotation: explore — read only. Cite file evidence; mark unknowns OPEN.

steps.content: {"cwd":"aetherlink-classroom-starter","actions":["list glossary/","read one sample entry","find start/validate scripts"],"mutate":false}
steps.annotation: explore — map structure without editing.

steps.content: {"glossary_path":"data/glossary/","sample":"token.json","fields":["term","definition","sources"],"validate":"npm test","OPEN":["whether NL labels are required"]}
steps.annotation: Evidence from files. OPEN stays OPEN — do not guess.

steps.content: HUMAN GATE · plan — propose the smallest change; wait for approval before Create/change.
steps.annotation: plan before change. Classroom pedagogy maps Create→change.

steps.content: Plan: add data/glossary/hallucination.json with term, short definition, and one open source field left OPEN until a human verifies a URL. No other files. Await approval.
steps.annotation: plan — smallest change; scope explicit.

steps.content: Approved. Proceed with that one file only.
steps.annotation: Human approved the plan — now change.

steps.content: {"file":"data/glossary/hallucination.json","op":"create","body":{"term":"hallucination","definition":"Model output that sounds plausible but is not grounded in evidence.","sources":["OPEN"]}}
steps.annotation: change (Create) — one edit after plan approval.

steps.content: {"wrote":"data/glossary/hallucination.json","diff_lines":12}
steps.annotation: Single file changed. Next: verify with a real command.

steps.content: {"cmd":"npm test","cwd":"aetherlink-classroom-starter"}
steps.annotation: verify (Test) — run the real check you will cite.

steps.content: {"exit":0,"summary":"glossary schema OK · 1 new entry"}
steps.annotation: Observed outcome. Review PASS/REVISE/OPEN with this evidence.

steps.content: HUMAN GATE · review — PASS with note: sources still OPEN until a verified URL is added.
steps.annotation: Human review before handoff/commit.

steps.content: Handoff / commit note: file data/glossary/hallucination.json · cmd npm test → exit 0 · limitation sources=OPEN · next owner: reviewer who can confirm a citation.
steps.annotation: commit (Handoff) — file · command · result · limitation · owner.

nl.title: Agent-loop · explore → plan → change → verify → commit
nl.description: Stap een kleine Aether Library-repotaak door de Claude Code-loop — explore, plan, change, verify, commit — zonder API-sleutels.

steps.content: In mijn lokale Aether Library-kloon: voeg één glossary-term "hallucination" toe volgens de bestaande structuur. Verzin geen bronnen. Stop voor goedkeuring vóór je een bestand schrijft.
steps.annotation: Kleinste nuttige wijziging. Zelfde voertuig als solos A1–A4.

steps.content: Start bij explore: ik lees alleen. Mapping van Profiles, Glossary, Library en hoe glossary-entries zijn opgebouwd.
steps.annotation: explore — alleen lezen. Citeer bestandsbewijs; markeer onbekenden als OPEN.

steps.content: {"cwd":"aetherlink-classroom-starter","actions":["list glossary/","read one sample entry","find start/validate scripts"],"mutate":false}
steps.annotation: explore — structuur in kaart brengen zonder te bewerken.

steps.content: {"glossary_path":"data/glossary/","sample":"token.json","fields":["term","definition","sources"],"validate":"npm test","OPEN":["of NL-labels verplicht zijn"]}
steps.annotation: Bewijs uit de bestanden. OPEN blijft OPEN — niet gokken.

steps.content: MENSELIJKE GATE · plan — stel de kleinste wijziging voor; wacht op akkoord vóór Create/change.
steps.annotation: plan vóór change. Classroom-pedagogie mapt Create→change.

steps.content: Plan: voeg data/glossary/hallucination.json toe met term, korte definitie en één bronveld OPEN tot een mens een URL verifieert. Geen andere bestanden. Wacht op akkoord.
steps.annotation: plan — kleinste wijziging; scope expliciet.

steps.content: Akkoord. Ga door met alleen dat ene bestand.
steps.annotation: Mens heeft het plan goedgekeurd — nu change.

steps.content: {"file":"data/glossary/hallucination.json","op":"create","body":{"term":"hallucination","definition":"Modeluitvoer die aannemelijk klinkt maar niet op bewijs steunt.","sources":["OPEN"]}}
steps.annotation: change (Create) — één wijziging na planakkoord.

steps.content: {"wrote":"data/glossary/hallucination.json","diff_lines":12}
steps.annotation: Eén bestand gewijzigd. Volgende: verify met een echt commando.

steps.content: {"cmd":"npm test","cwd":"aetherlink-classroom-starter"}
steps.annotation: verify (Test) — draai de echte controle die je citeert.

steps.content: {"exit":0,"summary":"glossary schema OK · 1 nieuwe entry"}
steps.annotation: Waargenomen uitkomst. Review PASS/REVISE/OPEN met dit bewijs.

steps.content: MENSELIJKE GATE · review — PASS met notitie: sources blijven OPEN tot er een geverifieerde URL bij komt.
steps.annotation: Menselijke review vóór handoff/commit.

steps.content: Handoff / commit-notitie: bestand data/glossary/hallucination.json · cmd npm test → exit 0 · beperking sources=OPEN · volgende eigenaar: reviewer die een bron kan bevestigen.
steps.annotation: commit (Handoff) — bestand · commando · uitkomst · beperking · eigenaar.
